buildingContext: The Mississauga atlas and reviewed refinement models continue into western Toronto using the City of Toronto’s native 2025 massing and topographic mapping. The Toronto addition contains 20,679 source records/components, not a count of separately verified current occupied buildings. Source buildings retain their native relative forms and are registered to the shared Ontario terrain. Detailed provenance is in subway-toronto-context.json.
limits: No selected alignment, station sites, depth, structure dimensions, funding or opening date.
Toronto context reflects municipal source dates. Coverage extends through Sherway and past Kipling; source omissions or later changes may remain.
Potential intermediate stops and transfer walking distances are unresolved.
Dundas BRT is a separate project and not replaced by this illustration.
Historical D3 was screened out and is not represented as approved.
The 2001 City Centre option was screened out on then-regional priorities and length/cost staging constraints; no current feasibility or ridership conclusion is implied.
Route alternatives are comparative author sketches, not engineering fallbacks; no ranking, cost or feasibility conclusion is implied.
